title: Reward-conditioned cerebellar response prediction

titles: Cerebellar granule-cell/climbing-fiber reward learning with dopamine and optogenetic perturbations

scientific_question: Can a neural response model predict registered-cell calcium under a held-out reward-delay or reward-type condition?
primary_outputs: Trial-by-cell response trajectories for the withheld reward condition.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: mainData1/2.mat contain micedats trial/session structures. Inspected IOChRmine_imaging reads rewAlgn.sigFilt_right_green as trial × cell × time; MainData separates GrC and CF populations and uses chronicGreen/chronicRed matches where available.
recording_contract.labels: rewarded, goodMvmt, movement length/pose, sol stimulation signal, DAType (DAT/MFB), delay condition, CFType/GrCs fields, water matches and experiment-specific inhibition/control data are described and used by the source.
recording_contract.time_alignment: tmpxx is the event-aligned time vector; winfn selects time windows. dtb converts behavioral sample indices such as rewtimes into seconds. startAlgn and rewAlgn expose distinct alignment choices; benchmark must freeze which is supplied.
recording_contract.biological_ids: MainData obtains mouse names by splitting dirTable.DA_Dir and counts unique mice. Dated acquisition-path strings are retained provenance identifiers, not required local paths. Alt_Delay_Dir/WaterDir plus chronic registration link repeated conditions; group these under one animal.
recording_contract.evidence: Versioned 11-asset manifest including ten MAT inputs and the code ZIP; archive README and MainData/IOChRmine/IOChRmine_imaging inspected. Individual optional fields differ by session; no MAT payload loaded.
